retries: No automatic upstream mutation retries. Retry explicit failed deletions; unknown create outcomes need provider dashboard reconciliation.
history: Deleting shared documents removes them from retrieval. Prior excerpts remain isolated in visitor conversations until clear-chat, new-session or session expiry.
grounding: Presenter drafts at most6 natural sentences, each at most500characters and total2600characters, using only selected uploaded evidence. Every sentence carries1to3 exact source quotations, each at most900characters. Invalid evidence discards its entire sentence. Whitespace-only matching preserves the original source span; wrong in-range chunk references may be repaired only against another allowed retrieved source. Unknown source references remain invalid. A second independent model call must approve every factual claim and faithful translation before its sentence is returned. Missing, duplicate or malformed verifier verdicts fail closed. No approved evidence means localized refusal. Citations contain original evidence; main content contains natural speech with terminal citation anchors. Each verified sentence is separated by a blank line for speech playback highlighting. English and Chinese are supported; auto follows the question language or explicit language request. At most2generation calls per answer; retrieval is separate. Semantic checking and retrieval relevance remain model-dependent and cannot guarantee zero hallucination.

voice.migration: Replace HTTP speech integration before shutdown. gpt-realtime-2.1-mini is not a drop-in /audio/speech model.

presentationRuntime: Local Poppler pdfinfo/pdftoppm required. Text via optional pdftotext or PYTHON_BIN+pypdf; empty pages use OpenAI visible-text OCR. PPTX requires configured Windows PowerPoint; refuses existing PowerPoint process. Remote hosting conversion remains unverified.
scriptPersistence: Newest existing legacy cache per slide/language adopted once. Fixed canonical generated script retained permanently; manual version takes precedence. Support docs affect Q&A only. Saving never calls LLM or validates user-provided narration as source facts. Manual text and literal citation-like markers read verbatim.
questionPolicy: Automatic questions only on saved selectedslides; unconfigureddefaultlastslide. Manualquestion entry remains available. Sharedsettings savedindependently of scripts/language/session and removedwithdeck.
animation: Detect actual PPTXtiming/transitions in presentationorder. NativePowerPointrendered MP4 clips required; PDFremainsstatic. Browsermutesvideo and startswithactualnarrationonplay; auto-advancewaitsboth speechandvideo. ExistingWindowsPowerPointrefused; unsupported effects/conversionfailures keepstaticpreview with clearstatus. No CSSapproximation counted as nativeanimation.

embeddedVideo.sequence: Saved static narration first; then native video with audio; await ended. Video failure blocks advancement. Ordinary animations remain parallel/muted.
